name: ConnectKit
summary: React component library docs for adding a wallet connection to a dApp, with themes, translations and wagmi support.
description: Documentation for ConnectKit 1.9.1, a React component library that connects a wallet to a dApp: connect button, chain setup, Sign In With Ethereum, theming (fonts, border radius, colors, avatar) and translations. It is TypeScript ready and builds on wagmi; Family hosts it alongside the docs for its own self-custody account.
